one_liner: The card says "Play a short game for a welcome-back surprise!" and never says what the surprise is.
author: aadi

change.offer_copy: Play a short game for a welcome-back surprise!

flow_steps.caption: A user who hasn't opened Luzia in 3+ days lands on Chats as usual.
A welcome-back card offers a surprise for a short game.
The user plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
The card changes to '3 Advanced reasoning answers ready today. Start a chat.'
